artifacts.summary: Seven-phase, 12-hour plan: formula renderer + glyphs, certificate-derived witness, shared color predicate (systemic), bimodal printer rewrite, align_vertically table view, iteration diffs, and docs/final gate.

memory_candidates.content: ModelChecker printed-output plumbing: colors are gated framework-wide by `output is sys.__stdout__` (no isatty/NO_COLOR), so capsys/StringIO tests never see ANSI codes; `builder/module.py::_capture_model_output` renders once into StringIO under --save and `ANSIToMarkdown` only understands red (\033[31m) and green (\033[32m), stripping everything else. Any theory printer change must keep information textual (never color-only) and route non-ASCII glyphs through `utils/glyphs.glyph` with a cp1252 real-stream test per TESTING_GUIDE.md section 9.
